result.rule: When the description explicitly states that activities can happen in parallel or that one activity occurs during another activity: Model those activities as concurrent branches and preserve their stated dependencies and order; do not impose a sequential order that the description does not require.

When the description states that work proceeds concurrently and that a later step must wait until all of that work is complete: Model the concurrent work as parallel branches and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before the dependent step.
